warning: Red areas are DWR’s Areas Closed to Waterfowl Hunting. DWR publishes no map of them: lakes and bays use their USGS water outline, Hog Island refuge DWR’s WMA outline, and the rest are approximate circles at the place the rule names — read each rule. Lands End WMA’s 1,000-yard closure (Rappahannock River, King George) is in the rules only. Federal refuges have their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: Virginia DWR, Waterfowl Blind Laws — Areas Closed to Waterfowl Hunting (2026–27).

Closed to waterfowl hunting: Hog Island State Waterfowl Refuge (Surry) and all the waters of the James River within 1,000 yards of the island, except DWR’s own blinds. Outline: DWR’s Hog Island WMA; the 1,000-yard water band is not drawn.
